extra_context: We're a little neighborhood salon I run with two other stylists out of an old converted house on the east side. Most of our folks have been coming for years, so it's pretty personal — you get the same chair, same person, and we actually remember what you asked for last time. I want the site to feel warm and unhurried, like sitting down with someone who knows your hair. One thing we're a bit known for is that every first-time appointment starts with a real cup of tea and a slow consult before anyone touches scissors.
